Here’s a quick rundown of the most common “tools” (websites, apps, APIs, and platforms) you can use to book flights, from the big name aggregators to the APIs that travel‑tech companies build on.

| Category | Tool / Service | What it does | Typical use‑case |
|----------|----------------|--------------|------------------|
| **Online travel agencies (OTAs)** | **Expedia** | Search & book flights, hotels, car rentals, packages. | General consumer booking, bundle deals. |
| | **Kayak** | Aggregates prices from many OTAs and airlines. | Price comparison, “price alerts.” |
| | **Priceline** | Similar to Kayak, plus “Name Your Own Price” and “Express Deals.” | Last‑minute or discounted fares. |
| | **Orbitz** | OTA with rewards program. | Frequent traveler rewards. |
| | **Hotwire** | Focuses on “opaque” bookings (price only, no airline shown until after booking). | Cheap last‑minute flights. |
| | **Travelocity** | OTA with a focus on family travel. | Family vacation packages. |
| | **CheapOair** | OTA with a strong mobile app. | Quick mobile bookings. |
| | **Momondo** | Price‑comparison engine, very visual. | Quick price comparison across many sources. |
| | **Google Flights** | Fast search engine, price graph, “Explore” map. | Quick price trend analysis. |
| | **Skyscanner** | Global search engine, “Everywhere” search. | Finding cheapest destinations. |
| | **Trip.com** | Chinese OTA with global reach. | Cheap fares in Asia. |
| | **Opodo** | European OTA. | European travel deals. |
| | **Booking.com** | Primarily hotels, but also flights. | Hotel‑flight bundles. |
| | **Airbnb Experiences** | Not flights, but sometimes includes “fly‑and‑stay” packages. | Experiential travel. |
| | **Airbnb** | Occasionally offers “Airbnb Adventures” that include flights. | Adventure travel. |
| | **Agoda** | Hotel OTA that also sells flights in some markets. | Asian travel. |
| | **Ctrip / Trip.com** | Chinese OTA with flight booking. | Cheap fares in China. |
| | **Traveloka** | Southeast Asian OTA. | Cheap regional flights. |
| | **MakeMyTrip** | Indian OTA. | Domestic & international flights in India. |
| | **Cleartrip** | Indian OTA. | Domestic flights, trains, hotels. |
| | **Yatra** | Indian OTA. | Domestic & international flights. |
| | **KAYAK** | Already listed, but worth repeating for its mobile app. | Mobile price alerts. |
| | **Google Flights** | Already listed, but worth repeating for its price‑prediction feature. | Predictive pricing. |
| | **FlightRadar24** | Flight tracker, not booking, but useful for real‑time flight status. | Checking flight status. |
| | **FlightAware** | Similar to FlightRadar24. | Real‑time flight tracking. |
| | **FlightStats** | API for flight status, delays, etc. | Integrate into travel apps. |
| | **SITA** | Airline IT solutions, not a consumer tool. | Airline operations. |
| | **Amadeus** | Global distribution system (GDS) API. | Travel agencies, airlines, OTAs. |
| | **Sabre** | GDS, API, and travel tech platform. | Travel agencies, airlines. |
| | **Travelport** | GDS, API, and travel tech platform. | Travel agencies, airlines. |
| | **Airline APIs** | e.g., United, Delta, Southwest, Lufthansa, etc. | Direct booking, fare search. |
| | **Google Flights API** | (Not publicly available, but Google offers a Flights API for partners). | Integrate flight search into apps. |
| | **Skyscanner API** | Search, price alerts, flight availability. | Build custom flight search. |
| | **Kiwi.com API** | Multi‑carrier itineraries, “virtual interlining.” | Build custom booking engines. |
| | **Travelpayouts** | Affiliate flight booking API. | Monetize flight search. |
| | **OpenSky API** | Real‑time flight data. | Flight tracking. |
| | **FlightAware API** | Flight status, delay predictions. | Integrate into travel apps. |
| | **FlightStats API** | Flight status, delays, historical data. | Data analytics. |
| | **AirLabs API** | Flight data, airports, airlines. | Data enrichment. |
| | **FlightHub API** | Flight booking for travel agencies. | Agency booking. |
| | **Travelport Universal API** | Booking, inventory, pricing. | Travel agencies. |
| | **Amadeus Self‑Service APIs** | Flight search, booking, itinerary. | Build travel apps. |
| | **Sabre APIs** | Flight search, booking, inventory. | Build travel apps. |
| | **Travelport APIs** | Flight search, booking, inventory. | Build travel apps. |
| | **Airline Loyalty APIs** | Earn & redeem miles. | Loyalty program integration. |
| | **Google Maps API** | Map flights, airports. | Visualize flight routes. |
| | **Mapbox API** | Custom maps for flight routes. | Visual flight mapping. |
| | **Microsoft Azure Maps** | Flight route visualization. | Visual flight mapping. |
| | **AWS Flight Data** | Flight data analytics. | Data science. |
| | **OpenFlights** | Open database of airports, airlines, routes. | Data research. |
| | **FlightAware FlightXML** | Flight status, delay predictions. | Data integration. |

---

### How to pick the right tool

| Goal | Recommended tool(s) | Why |
|------|---------------------|-----|
| **Quick consumer booking** | Google Flights, Skyscanner, Kayak, Expedia | Fast UI, price comparison, price alerts. |
| **Last‑minute or discounted fares** | Priceline, Hotwire, Orbitz | Opaque deals, “express” discounts. |
| **Bundle travel (flight + hotel + car)** | Expedia, Priceline, Orbitz | One‑stop shop, often cheaper. |
| **Frequent‑flyer loyalty integration** | Amadeus, Sabre, Travelport APIs | Earn & redeem miles, loyalty program data. |
| **Build a custom travel app** | Amadeus Self‑Service APIs, Skyscanner API, Kiwi.com API | Full control over UI, pricing, booking flow. |
| **Real‑time flight status** | FlightAware API, FlightRadar24 API, FlightStats API | Integrate live status into your app. |
| **Data analytics / research** | OpenSky Network, OpenFlights, FlightStats, FlightAware | Historical flight data, delay analysis. |
| **Affiliate marketing** | Travelpayouts, Skyscanner Affiliate | Earn commissions on bookings. |
| **Mobile‑first booking** | Airbnb, Booking.com, Skyscanner mobile app | Optimized for touch, push notifications. |

---

### Quick start for developers

1. **Choose an API** – e.g., Amadeus Self‑Service Flight Offers Search.
2. **Sign up** – Get API keys from the provider’s developer portal.
3. **Read the docs** – Look at the “search” endpoint, required parameters (origin, destination, dates, cabin class).
4. **Make a request** – Use `curl` or a library in your language of choice.
5. **Parse the response** – Extract flight options, prices, availability.
6. **Book** – Use the “booking” endpoint (often a separate call after selecting an offer).

---

### Bottom line

- **For everyday travelers**: Google Flights, Skyscanner, Kayak, Expedia, Priceline, and similar OTAs are the easiest way to find and book flights.
- **For developers**: Amadeus, Sabre, Travelport, Skyscanner, Kiwi.com, and Travelpayouts provide robust APIs to embed flight search and booking into your own apps or services.
- **For real‑time flight data**: FlightAware, FlightRadar24, FlightStats, and OpenSky Network give you live status, delays, and historical data.

Pick the tool that matches your audience (consumer vs. developer) and your specific needs (price comparison, real‑time status, loyalty integration, etc.). Happy flying!
